title: DYNAMIS Agent Passport + Directory Record
description: One agent as the directory sees it (docs/04 §4). Keys never appear — only HSM keyrefs (Law 3). Capabilities are scoped, time-boxed, revocable (Law 18). The persona never claims to represent the root (Law 17).

persona.description: Display identity on public rails. Bio text must never claim root/entity representation unless a charter says so (Law 17).

keyrefs.description: HSM key references only. Raw or WIF key material anywhere in this object is a census-failing incident (Laws 1–3).

scope.description: e.g. jobs:claim, compute:serve, treasury:read — least capability that works (Law 18).

census_day.description: Protocol day the custody census last judged every keyref alive (Law 2). Stale census = agent suspended from value paths.

chain_proofs.description: saos.id.v1-style cross-network proofs (estate rails / EVM) bound to this agent.

attestation_grades.description: Highest verified classes this agent has honestly completed.

brier_history_ref.description: Reference to the evaluator's calibration report (Gate 3.2).
